description: This Java source file defines the class IntellijLintProject and its nested subclasses, which represent different types of Android projects and modules for lint analysis within IntelliJ IDEA, including support for Gradle and Android library projects.

classes.name: IntellijLintProject
classes.description: Represents a lint project in IntelliJ, supporting modules, Android projects, and libraries, with subclasses for specific project types.

classes.name: IntellijLintProject.LintModuleProject
classes.description: Represents a non-Android module project, providing source and class folder information.

classes.name: IntellijLintProject.LintAndroidProject
classes.description: Represents an Android module project, providing access to manifest, resource, and dependency information.

classes.name: IntellijLintProject.LintGradleProject
classes.description: Represents a Gradle-based Android project with additional manifest and dependency handling.

classes.name: IntellijLintProject.LintGradleLibraryProject
classes.description: Represents a Gradle Android library project.

classes.name: IntellijLintProject.LintGradleLibraryProject
classes.description: Represents a Gradle Android library project.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a list of lint projects for given modules and files.

methods.name: createForSingleFile
methods.description: Creates a lint project for a single file within a module.

methods.name: addProjects
methods.description: Recursively adds projects and dependencies for a module.

methods.name: createModuleProject
methods.description: Creates a lint project for a specific module.

methods.name: hasAndroidModule
methods.description: Checks if a project has an Android module.

methods.name: findAndroidFacetInProject
methods.description: Finds an AndroidFacet in a project.

methods.name: addGradleLibraryProjects
methods.description: Adds Gradle library projects as dependencies.

methods.name: dependsOn
methods.description: Checks if a dependencies object depends on a specific artifact.

methods.name: depsDependsOn
methods.description: Checks if a project depends on a specific artifact.
